title: Incoming root estimates on the full diffraction support
source_hypothesis: Actual H1 solution, L2 source with every tangential Sobolev order on a fixed parameter neighborhood, and ordinary regularity of a short negative-normal incoming germ at a strict anchor. The target support is compact inside the hyperbolic region.
reviewed_arguments: I0 fixes the actual H1 domain, L2 source, all tangential source orders on one common neighborhood, arbitrary complex matrix lower coefficients and a regular negative-normal incoming germ. The source hypothesis gives ordinary regularity at every finite-normal lift.

I1 follows the reversed full Hamilton flow. The negative normal component decreases, the base normal coordinate increases, and the reference slice is transverse. Smooth hitting maps, continuity of the negative square root at glancing and compact arc containment provide one neighborhood independent of Sobolev order. Interior target tubes are not extended through a turning point.

I2 constructs one full matrix root on the finite union of hyperbolic tubes, imposes Aminus=-Aplus exactly, and cancels every ordinary lower defect with all normal parameter derivatives. Both the full factorization remainder and the root-extension discrepancy are retained on the actual input.

I3 retains the order-zero matrix commutator in the transported cutoff. The correction has the exact sign Tq=-i d and uses ordered fundamental matrices and their actual inverses. Supported summation and the initial smoothing correction give an exact terminal operator and a full smoothing commutator.

I4 proves the actual first-order equation, including all source and extension terms. The original L2 function has a genuine Hminus-one-half trace. Both evolution orientations and negative-order adjoint uniqueness identify its Duhamel formula without assuming smooth trace data.

I5 separates the source integral, which is smooth only tangentially, from the homogeneous matrix evolution. The latter has the full spacetime characteristic graph and no pure normal wavefront. Finite-normal pseudolocality, transverse pullback and Sobolev trace identification recover the smooth actual terminal datum from the regular incoming germ.

I6 covers the whole compact incoming support with finitely many elliptic commuting tests and one full root. Exact parametrices retain all remainders. The two SDC supports can be chosen inside the fixed geometric neighborhood after the damping constant is fixed; constants may depend on the root gap.

I7 checks the actual LG/ECR corrected solution and source. Its incoming estimate meets LG4 on both whole supports and supplies the finite-order Dirichlet receiving theorem. It does not infer a common-neighborhood iteration or a Neumann/Robin boundary estimate.

Three solved exercises check a matrix transport correction, a full-root versus principal-root H1 example, and a complete incoming family with a strict slice margin. Thirty-four exact checks supplement the analytic proofs.
Eleven overlapping desktop captures, the whole exact figure and two mobile samples were inspected. All 275 formulas and 29 displays parse; all display and figure extents are accessible on mobile.
Twelve entries bind to 1376 earlier entries in 78 maps, including 102 external Lebl providers. The export does not have internal P514 closure. All nine approved books remain admitted.
